title: Spotlight snapshot: owner tiling + mini census
content:
Purpose:
Quick single-sheet census for weekend/day-of sprint coverage where we need lightweight owner 'tiling' across infra, serving, and infra-SRE. Not authoritative — use as a fast handoff for on-call and event hops.

Instructions (how to use):
- Fill rows for any route/team you touch. Keep notes short.
- Primary = person who will take first escalation. Backup = second-line who can field longer troubleshooting.
- Coverage = local hours covered (PST/UTC window).
- Swap status: open / requested / confirmed.
- Risk = low/med/high (quick rationale).
- Action items at bottom; assign and mark done.

Snapshot table (columns): Route | Primary | Backup | Region | Coverage (UTC) | Swap status | Risk | Notes / quick runbook pointer
1) api-ingest-01 | Priya Raman | Diego Martinez | us-west | 00:00-08:00 | confirmed | med | prefix-cache warmup flaky; see runbook: confluence.company/ingest-cache
2) runtime-gpu-pool | Liam O'Connor | Ava Chen | us-central | 12:00-20:00 | open | high | burst queue spikes during demo windows — consider temporary scale policy; Jira: PLAT-512
3) kv-cache-proxy | Diego Martinez | Maria Novak | eu-west | 06:00-14:00 | requested | med | short-circuit on cold-start; temp patch applied 2029-01-14
4) embeddings-rt | Priya Raman | Nikhil Sharma | global | 18:00-02:00 | confirmed | low | healthy; watch tokenizer mismatches on model v2.1
5) private-deployments-ops | Ava Chen | TBD | ap-south | 22:00-06:00 | open | high | customer-demo Friday; need SLA contact and fallback plan (see linked doc)
6) console-rollouts | Samir Patel | Priya Raman | us-east | 08:00-16:00 | confirmed | low | can route to staging if telemetry skips

Light scoring heuristics (quick):
- High risk if: single owner + external customer demo + recent patch in last 72h.
- Medium risk if: single owner + non-critical demo or recent config changes.
- Low risk if: covered by >1 owner and no recent changes.

Open swaps & requests:
- runtime-gpu-pool: Liam out 1/20-1/22, requested backup. Action: Diego to confirm availability by 1/16.
- private-deployments-ops: replacing backup — ask SE rotations team to nominate (Ticket: SE-278).

Action items (assignments):
- [Ava] Draft one-line fallback paragraphs for private-deployments and attach to this sheet (due 2029-01-16).
- [Diego] Confirm backup for runtime-gpu-pool or propose short-term scale policy (due 2029-01-16).
- [Priya] Add runbook pointer for api-ingest-01 cache issue and short triage checklist (done? update).
- [Liam] Post availability in #ops-oncall and flag any latency SLO concerns.

Notes / loose threads (notes-to-self style):
- We should consider a tiny helper script to scrape this sheet and populate a temporary rota in Slack for weekend coverage. Low priority but useful.
- Is there appetite for a standardized "demo-day" label to quickly bump risk scoring? Might simplify triage.
- Cross-ref: platform console rollout schedule (product asks) — ensure console-rollouts owner aware of v2 testing window 1/19-1/21.

Version history (quick):
- 2029-01-15 created initial census by Ava (seed rows).
- 2029-01-16 Diego + Priya added notes and backups.
- 2029-01-18 cleaned up statuses, set action owners.

Quick links (useful during handoff):
- Oncall rota: https://oncall.company/rota/platform
- Incident channel: slack://channel/ops-oncall
- Escalation matrix: confluence.company/EscalationMatrix

Unresolved questions:
- Who will be nominal backup for private-deployments-ops for 1/19? Need response by 1/17.
- Do we permit temporary external contractor as backup in emergency? (needs approval from security/compliance)

Intended audience: Platform eng leads, SRE shift leads, SE rotation coordinators, on-call engineers.

-- end --
